definitions: A rich, emulsified sauce made from egg yolks, melted butter, and lemon juice or vinegar, often seasoned with salt and a pinch of cayenne pepper.
A classic French sauce, typically served with eggs, asparagus, or fish.
examples: Eggs Benedict are incomplete without hollandaise sauce.
She made a batch of hollandaise sauce from scratch.
The chef drizzled hollandaise sauce over the poached salmon.
